town.title: Town Council
town.difficulty: everyday to hard tasks on small accounts
town.planningMode: CLOOP town. Apply the main prompt; after any compaction or context loss, reread it and cloop/board.md. Route line first (DIRECT / FOCUSED / FULL). Counter the defaults: remove before adding, whole before detail, goal before measure. DEFINE: the council drafts the rubric (G0 first; CORE / NON-CORE / Backlog / Drop; one decidable property per criterion), and spec and architecture in cloop/ for a new repo; run each criterion's wording on real cases; freeze. EXPLORE when the output shape is unclear: 3–5 parallel single-file one-shots, judged blind, winner by rule. CLIMB: CORE stage, then NON-CORE stage, each = one-shot → small loops → gate. One-shot: PREVENT, ONE self-contained file (Rosetta if the stack is unfamiliar), real run, check (good ≈80%, range 60–100%: integrate, delete the file; bad: re-DEFINE or EXPLORE). Small loop: PREVENT (reproduce on BEST; LOCAL / RELATIONAL / UNSETTLED / UNDECIDABLE) → brief quoting the criterion → smallest correction on BEST, seen failing on BEST → judges on a frozen commit, probing in probe worktrees → one CORRECT or ACCEPT. Gates: core, then release (full run + full suite once + full review); only runs and deterministic checks reproduce; only reproduced required violations block. Every outcome except PASS → a step back, one board line, in the status line. Outcomes: REGRESSION, PASS, ADVANCED, BLOCKED, STALLED. Triggers override allowances; ladder: repair differently → DUEL → EXPLORE → re-DEFINE, each rung once per criterion. Judges = reviewers (read-only); duelers = loop-breakers. A failed call: re-dispatch once, then stop that role; never substitute. Builders, if listed: BUILDERS. Never reinterpret the rubric, accept a proxy, weaken a test, skip judging, or count a rubric change as progress. Status line + two tables + Next after every check, loop and gate. Autonomous until a real blocker. Delete task files on PASS.
